method.wall: Elapsed time around the complete npm process, including startup, Vite setup and teardown.
method.cpu: Linux descendant-process CPU ticks sampled every 500ms, with CLK_TCK=100. Values are active logical-core equivalents, not percentages of the whole machine. Short-lived processes can escape samples; these are qualitative pressure indicators, not power or temperature measurements.
method.ordering: Benchmark processes ran sequentially. Unit worker counts were repeated in reversed order. Browser worker counts had one initial run each; an 8-worker baseline was repeated after the session restart.
method.priorEvidence: Prior-session figures were retained from captured tool outputs. Temporary raw files were lost on the WSL session restart; hardware, OS and Node/npm versions matched after restart.

profiles.notes: Timings overlap: browserEvaluation includes imports, loop, diagnostics and hashing; Canvas and policy timers sit inside the loop, with initial presentation just before it. readDiagnostics includes whole-trace canonical serialization and hashing. Block transfer includes lazy browser checkpoint hashing; comparison includes lazy Node checkpoint hashing. Corpus navigation timing covers run fixtures, not the two settlement navigations. These are wall-clock phase timings, not a sampled CPU attribution.
